cases.name: knowledge-scan: after the first sync, the commit carrying the sync row is covered — nothing to do
cases.cmd:
K={{KIT}}/scripts; B={{FIX}}/ks-synced; rm -rf $B; cp -R {{FIX}}/ks-boot $B; cd $B
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$B
printf '{"product": "Shop", "knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT", "Studio": "STU"}}}' > .claude/kit.config.json
ST=$(python3 $K/knowledge-write.py init); mkdir -p $ST/Catalog/usecases $ST/Studio/usecases
printf '# CAT-CU-?1 — Archive a product

Withdraw.

## Rules

Outcome: `ProductNotPublishedException`

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `ArchiveProductCommandHandler`: load, archive, save.
' > "$ST/Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-?1-archive-product.md"
printf '# CAT-CU-?2 — Consult products

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `GetProductQueryHandler`: load.
' > "$ST/Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-?2-consult-products.md"
printf '# STU-CU-?1 — Add a node

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `AddNodeCommandHandler`: add.
' > "$ST/Studio/usecases/STU-CU-?1-add-node.md"
python3 $K/knowledge-write.py apply >/dev/null && git add -A && git commit -qm "docs: knowledge base"
python3 $K/knowledge-scan.py --context Catalog

cases.name: knowledge-scan: sync rows of two merged branches are both marks — only what came after is read
cases.cmd:
K={{KIT}}/scripts; R={{FIX}}/ks-merge-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; cp -R {{FIX}}/ks-synced $R; cd $R; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R
git checkout -qb side
sed -i.bak 's/p.Archive();/p.Archive(); p.Save();/' src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/ArchiveProduct/ArchiveProductCommandHandler.cs && rm src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/ArchiveProduct/ArchiveProductCommandHandler.cs.bak && python3 $K/knowledge-write.py mark --context Catalog >/dev/null && git add -A && git commit -qm 'fix: side'
git checkout -q - && sed -i.bak 's/Handle() { }/Handle() { Load(); }/' src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/GetProduct/GetProductQueryHandler.cs && rm src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/GetProduct/GetProductQueryHandler.cs.bak && python3 $K/knowledge-write.py mark --context Catalog >/dev/null && git add -A && git commit -qm 'fix: main'
git merge -q --no-edit side && test $(grep -c '| sync ' docs/business/Catalog/HISTORY.md) = 3 || echo MERGE-FAILED
printf '// new\npublic sealed class PublishProductCommandHandler { }\n' > src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/GetProduct/Extra.cs && git add -A && git commit -qm 'feat: extra'
python3 $K/knowledge-scan.py --json --context Catalog | python3 -c "import json,sys; x=json.load(sys.stdin)['contexts'][0]; d=x['delta']; print(len(x['marks']), d['commits'], [c['path'].rsplit('/',1)[1] for c in d['changes']])"
